description: Zielkulisse ELER Trinkwasserschutz Niedersachsen is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by nlwkn.niedersachsen.de. Calculated basic target set for EU funding programmes for the purpose of drinking water protection measures without overlays (the higher-quality/safer one was retained). Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Target setting EAFRD Drinking Water Protection Lower Saxony" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 3 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2021-01-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
